sketch: DE||BC, DE=BC/2 (K210 on ABC); FG||DE, FG=DE/2 (K210 on ADE); FG||BC; FG=BC/4.
statements: In triangle ABC, D is the midpoint of side AB and E is the midpoint of side AC.
In triangle ADE, F is the midpoint of side AD and G is the midpoint of side AE.
Express the length FG in terms of the length BC, and state how FG is directed relative to BC.
target: FG equals BC/4 and FG is parallel to BC.

trace.concl: DE is parallel to BC and DE equals BC/2.
from: D is the midpoint of side AB and E is the midpoint of side AC
